chipSemantics.outputRate: sample_rate returns configured host rate. Internal tick clock/384 using64-bit phase, sample-and-hold. Reset phase=rate*384 makes first output evaluate sample0. Writes do not force prior output or discard held left/right.
chipSemantics.memory: 64KiB RAM initialized zero. reset preserves RAM; clearMemory zeroes RAM without resetting voices/phase/held outputs. Absolute load bounds checks whole range; public empty load returns without access. Raw CPU writeMemory uint16(bank OR offset); public window offset bounded0..FFF. readMemory is absolute uint16 address. loadBankedMemory absolute data block uses current bank OR offset, then normal range checks.
chipSemantics.registers: Eight channels, channel bank selected by controlbit6. Same controlbit7 globally enables ticks, RAMbank selection ifbit6clear. Channel-enable register8 active-low; disabled voices rewind addr to start<<19. Start register changes addr only when voice disabled.
chipSemantics.formatPanLoop: Sign-magnitude encodedPCM:bit7 positive, low7 magnitude, FF loop marker. Loop marker reloads loopStart<<11, secondFF leaves address there without advance. Step16-bit fixed11fraction, RAMread wraps16-bit. Pan low4left/high4right, multiplied envelope and integer >>5 pervoice; summed and clamped16-bit before /32768.
chipSemantics.readBus: Native read offsets repeat0..15 mapping8channels address byte via addr>>11/19; not saved register echo or IRQ status. Registers outside0..8 ignored.
chipSemantics.state: Save/load serialized state has rate/clock/channelbank/globalenable/RAMbank/phase/held outputs, all8channel fields and65536RAM bytes. Native exactsize check, no portablefile/version promise. Public state opaque frozen WeakMap same-instance token; foreign/fake reject. Output buffers not state.
chipSemantics.pcmApi: Owned generateStereo copies survive latergeneration/growth/disposal; no borrowedView/Into/reserve APIs on wrapper. No general post-dispose control guards added. Public read/write/memory methods preserve current bounded and unbounded behavior.
chipSemantics.resetHold: Globalenableoff silences on nextnative tick, not immediate outputframe if holdphase pending. Channeloff rewinds address immediately but heldPCM remains until nexttick. Stop/UI may add dedicated outputgate; do not infer raw immediate silence.

reports.method: Actual generated JS/WASM through unchanged Rf5c164 wrapper, exact owned stereo PCM and complete65,660-byte native state including64KiB RAM. Actual GenesisAudioEngine with current real YM2612/PSG WASM, existing gains and VgmPlayer opaque/checkpoint/seek. No mock, tolerance, Mixer or audio device.
limits: RF5C164 produces the configured output rate using its integer clock/(rate*384) phase accumulator and held native samples. All8voices, native signed-magnitude zeros, FF marker/loop, integer envelope and pan nibbles and both clamp endpoints are tested independently.

Public read() is current channel address bus readback, not a control-register mirror or status/IRQ interface. Public window writes have4KiB validation; raw offsets and banked loads use the existing OR combination. Absolute readMemory() is tested only at valid0..65535 offsets; its native narrow argument does not provide a public JavaScript out-of-range guarantee.

Complete raw state includes configured rate/clock, control/channel banks, all channel addresses and controls, fractional phase/held output and RAM. Cross-build loading is bounded to these exact trusted states with the same configuration. No arbitrary same-sized malformed state fuzzing: current loader validates only pointer and size. Public opaque snapshots remain same-instance/same-build tokens.

Raw and public Rf5c164.reset() retain RAM, reset controls/held output, and place the phase so the next output ticks immediately. clearMemory() clears RAM only and may retain held output until the next native tick. Existing GenesisAudioEngine.reset() also clears PCM RAM; it is tested separately.

Only owned generateStereo() is provided by this wrapper; no borrowed or Into API is invented. Actual returned arrays survive later writes, PCM capacity growth, real WASM heap growth and disposal. State guards after disposal are tested without calling unsafe general methods on handle0.

Actual Genesis Engine mixes FM0.9 + PSG0.35 + PCM1 using direct configured-rate calls. Idle FM baseline is included. Selected regular Engine cases replay complete opaque state, while raw bidirectional state restores are RF-only. Active FM reset-to-power-on equality is intentionally not asserted because YM2612 reset retains free-running timing.

Real VgmPlayer exercises b1 registers, c2 window writes and C1 banked RAM blocks, actual checkpoint/seek and same-instance opaque Player state. Sample data is original synthetic bytes. JSON contains state/RAM hashes, not repeated full RAM dumps.
No Browser/Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware or listening judgement is tested.

coverageReview.ramAndBus: All 65,536 valid absolute read addresses, 16 CPU banks, independent channel/window bank, 4KiB write bounds, OR versus addition, last RAM byte and invalid native lengths are positively checked. Bus reads independently derive channel-address bytes from state, not register echoes.
coverageReview.synthesisPositives: Signed-magnitude zeros/sign/extremes, immediate FF loop and double FF enabled silence, independent pan nibbles and envelope scaling, eight-voice positive/negative clamp endpoints, enabled/disabled start behavior, global disable address freeze/resume and independent integer tick/phase/held-output formulas agree with core.
coverageReview.resetAndClear: Raw/public chip reset retain RAM and evaluate the first native tick at next output. clearMemory leaves control/phase/held sample unchanged until next tick. Genesis reset clears PCM RAM separately.
coverageReview.actualEngine: Real GenesisAudioEngine uses real current YM2612 and Sega PSG with direct RF output at configured rate. Initial PCM source frames/calls are instrumented; baseline includes observed idle FM/PSG. Opaque Engine continuation restores complete state. Active FM positive starts from identical saved PCM phase. Active FM reset-to-power-on equality is excluded.
coverageReview.player: Original synthetic VGM exercises 0xb1 registers, 0xc2 CPU-window patch, 0x67/0xc1 RAM blocks including OR bank destination and last RAM page. Positive checkpoint restores occur 30 times per build.
coverageReview.accounting: Main continuation body starts at frame613 and includes fresh127-frame probes. Separate bounded selfchecks are 8089 frames per build. Player generated Engine frames are measured independently; delivered/requested Player frames and internal source frames are not added again.
